name: WhatsApp Health
query:
SELECT
	COALESCE(NULLIF(w.whatsapp_account, ''), '(no account)')            AS "Account:Data:170",
	w.type                                                              AS "Direction:Data:100",
	COUNT(*)                                                            AS "Messages:Int:95",
	SUM(COALESCE(w.reference_name, '') = '')                            AS "No lead:Int:85",
	SUM(w.status = 'sent')                                              AS "Sent:Int:80",
	SUM(w.status = 'delivered')                                         AS "Delivered:Int:95",
	SUM(w.status = 'read')                                              AS "Read:Int:75",
	SUM(w.status = 'failed')                                            AS "Failed:Int:80",
	SUM(w.type = 'Outgoing' AND COALESCE(w.status, '') = '')            AS "No status:Int:95",
	SUM(COALESCE(w.custom_media_type, '') <> '')                        AS "With media:Int:105",
	SUM(w.custom_media_state = 'Stored')                                AS "Media stored:Int:115",
	SUM(w.custom_media_state = 'Awaiting')                              AS "Refetch:Int:90",
	SUM(w.custom_media_state = 'Awaiting'
	    AND COALESCE(w.custom_media_ref, '') =  '')                      AS "No source:Int:100",
	SUM(w.custom_media_state = 'Abandoned')                             AS "Media abandoned:Int:135",
	MAX(w.custom_media_attempts)                                        AS "Max try:Int:80",
	MAX(w.creation)                                                     AS "Last message:Datetime:165",
	TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, MAX(w.creation), site.now_at)                       AS "Mins quiet:Int:100"
FROM `tabWhatsApp Message` w
CROSS JOIN (SELECT CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), '+00:00', value) AS now_at FROM `tabSingles` WHERE doctype = 'System Settings' AND field = 'time_zone') site
WHERE w.creation >= DATE_SUB(DATE(site.now_at), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
